argv: Capture from Chronicle and the journal (HC1-HC15, decision 0112; JN1-JN24, decision 0155)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone and an Android phone, with a journal of a few dozen entries, force-quit the app and open it on Memories; watch the latest entry. **Expect:** the sheet appears once, with the latest entry under today's date where it rests, and nothing slides or jumps after; a journal with nothing kept appears with its empty page and no gap longer than half a second. Never run on a device: the sheet's opacity gate and its one scroll to the end after the first measure. (fix entry-jitter)
